name: research
description: High-trust-source research with cited Markdown findings on planning / design questions, written to docs/research/<plan-slug>/<topic>.md. Thin contract layer over OMO librarian agent: this skill enforces a 4-type source whitelist (official docs, RFC, source-repo code, project ADRs / spec), inline citation format, plan-required invocation, async dispatch, and the decisions.md audit entry. Use when a planning decision needs an authoritative answer that should outlive the session as a citable record and candidate sources are official docs, RFCs, source-repo code, or project ADRs / spec. NOT for casual questions (use agent default tools), non-authoritative sources like Stack Overflow or blogs (link in See Also only — never cite as [ref]), or plan-less invocations (refuse: 'Plan context required.').

positive_triggers.input: I need to know what the latest Vue 3.5 RFC says about prop inheritance defaults — get an authoritative answer I can cite in the spec
positive_triggers.reason: Explicit 'authoritative answer I can cite' → matches 4-type whitelist (official docs / RFC / source-repo / spec) and a planning-context question → research

positive_triggers.input: Investigate the IANA header reservation rule for `Foo-Bar` so we can document it in the API contract
positive_triggers.reason: Investigate + IANA (official-docs / rfc) + planning context (API contract) → research

positive_triggers.input: Wayfinder ticket of type `research` — async-dispatch it and drop the findings path in the ticket Resolution
positive_triggers.reason: Wayfinder `research` ticket type → matches the documented dispatch target (async by default); the `task_id` is consumed by the ticket Resolution

negative_triggers.input: What's Next.js? I've never used it.
negative_triggers.reason: Casual knowledge question; no plan-scoped citable record needed → agent default tools, NOT research

negative_triggers.input: Look up the Stack Overflow answer for how to debounce in React and write a cited finding
negative_triggers.reason: Stack Overflow is non-authoritative; even if cited, the test suite refuses it. Goes in `See Also` at best, not `[ref]`

negative_triggers.input: /research topic=oauth2-flow without a plan open — just answer inline
negative_triggers.reason: Plan-less invocation → refuse with the verbatim literal `Plan context required. Open a plan first with /brainstorming or /ulw-plan.`

behavioral_evals.scenario: User is mid-plan on `skills-extension-v1` and asks: 'Investigate the citation discipline for me so the spec can cite it later. Mode: async — I want to keep planning.'
expected_behavior: Agent verifies plan slug is present (skills-extension-v1) — does NOT refuse
Agent verifies topic is new — does NOT find docs/research/skills-extension-v1/citation-discipline.md, so dispatches fresh
Agent picks mode=async per the user's explicit request and the heuristic (multi-source investigation)
Agent dispatches librarian with the verbatim dispatch prompt template (whitelist + format + section contract + refusal rule)
Agent returns IMMEDIATELY with the exact JSON shape {"status": "running", "task_id": "<id>"} — does NOT block on librarian

Background librarian writes docs/research/skills-extension-v1/citation-discipline.md with required frontmatter (topic, plan, ts, mode: async, status: complete, sources_used) and the 5 body sections in order
Background librarian uses ONLY the 4 whitelisted [ref:*] types — Stack Overflow / blog links go to See Also as plain markdown

Agent appends the audit entry `[research] ts=<iso8601> topic=citation-discipline findings=docs/research/skills-extension-v1/citation-discipline.md mode=async` to .omo/notepads/skills-extension-v1/decisions.md
Idempotent re-invocation reuses the existing output file and does not double-append decisions.md

behavioral_evals.scenario: User invokes /research with no plan context: '/research topic=foo' (no plan slug in current session)
expected_behavior: Agent refuses IMMEDIATELY with the verbatim literal: `Plan context required. Open a plan first with /brainstorming or /ulw-plan.`
Agent does NOT propose /tmp or any other fallback path — there is no plan-scoped place to land the output
Agent does NOT call librarian — refusal is upstream of dispatch
Agent does NOT create docs/research/<any>/foo.md — the output file path requires a plan slug

notes: Verified-level (2026-07-29): positive_keywords must appear in skills/extra/research/SKILL.md description body (CI gate from slice-review / ai-code-blindspots pattern). Source whitelist additions (new high-trust source types) require a brainstorming amend — see SKILL.md 'Source Whitelist' table for the 4 exact types. Librarian agent is the execution body; this skill does NOT modify librarian. The dispatch prompt template in SKILL.md § 'Dispatch Prompt Template' is the entire contract surface. Async dispatch is verified to return the exact `{"status": "running", "task_id": "<id>"}` shape within 100ms — see scripts/test-citation-discipline.sh case (f). Idempotency on (plan, topic) is verified by case (g) of the same script.
